bundle.shortDescription: The open-source cockpit for your coding agents
bundle.longDescription: A desktop for Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex and any Agent Client Protocol agent, running on the subscriptions you already pay for: chats beside a terminal, the files and the session panel; documents, spreadsheets, whiteboards and dashboards the agents produce and you edit; a board of every task; the cost of every chat; and a voice.
